settings.name: agent_offline_timeout_seconds
settings.description: Seconds without a heartbeat before an agent is marked offline.

settings.name: allowed_hosts
settings.description: Host header allow-list. Required in production.

settings.name: audit_chain_secret
settings.description: Independent HMAC key for the authenticated audit chain.

settings.name: audit_retention_days
settings.description: Days of audit-log history kept before the retention sweep removes rows.

settings.name: audit_webhook_url
settings.description: Optional write-only webhook that receives each signed audit head.

settings.name: bind_host
settings.description: Interface the brain's HTTP server binds to.

settings.name: bind_port
settings.description: Port the brain's HTTP server binds to.

settings.name: command_timeout_seconds
settings.description: Seconds a dispatched command may stay unacknowledged before it times out.

settings.name: cors_origins
settings.description: Origins allowed to call the API cross-site. Empty means same-origin only.

settings.name: database_url
settings.description: SQLAlchemy async database URL. Masked because it carries credentials.

settings.name: embedded_scheduler
settings.description: Run z4j-scheduler as a supervised subprocess inside the brain.

settings.name: environment
settings.description: Security posture. 'production' requires TLS and an explicit host allow-list.

settings.name: event_retention_days
settings.description: Days of task/event history kept before the retention sweep removes rows.

settings.name: log_json
settings.description: Emit structured JSON logs instead of human-readable console lines.

settings.name: log_level
settings.description: Root log level for the brain process.

settings.name: public_url
settings.description: Externally reachable base URL used in links and MFA issuer labels. Session cookies remain host-only.

settings.name: ratelimit_commands_per_minute
settings.description: Reserved compatibility setting; command issuance is not currently rate-limited from this value. Do not rely on it as a security boundary.

settings.name: registry_backend
settings.description: Agent-registry backend. 'postgres_notify' supports multi-process brains.

settings.name: require_db_ssl
settings.description: Outside dev mode, PostgreSQL URLs must select an accepted strict TLS mode. This setting does not apply to SQLite.

settings.name: scheduler_grpc_bind_port
settings.description: Port the scheduler-facing gRPC service binds to.

settings.name: scheduler_grpc_enabled
settings.description: Serve the gRPC endpoint that z4j-scheduler connects to.

settings.name: secret
settings.description: Master application key. Session-cookie signing uses the separate session_secret setting.

settings.name: session_absolute_lifetime_seconds
settings.description: Lifetime of an ordinary session. Remember-me sessions use the separate remember-me lifetime.

settings.name: session_idle_timeout_seconds
settings.description: Idle timeout for ordinary sessions. Remember-me sessions bypass this idle limit.
